files.name: ClimbShaft.java

help: climb_shaft: pillar straight up by mining the ceiling and placing blocks underfoot (after goto surface fails)
lesson: The staircase climb fails on hard blocks, side hazards and slow 240 s timeouts; a vertical pillar that feeds on its own mined cobble needs only one clear column and sidesteps when that column is blocked.
summary: climb_shaft: after goto surface fails UNREACHABLE, pillar straight up by hand (mine ceiling, jump, place mined block under feet), stepping sideways around lava/bedrock/hard blocks
